mapper.select: select * from ledger_invite where ledger_id = #{ledgerId} and invitee_id = #{inviteeId}
mapper.insert: insert into ledger_invite(ledger_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, status) values (#{ledgerId},#{inviterId},#{inviteeId},#{status})
mapper.select: select id, ledger_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, status, create_time, update_time from ledger_invite where id = #{inviteId}

select li.*, l.ledger_name, -- 邀请人姓名（inviter_id → user） u1.username as inviterName, -- 被邀请人姓名（invitee_id → user） u2.username as inviteeName from ledger_invite li left join ledger l on li.ledger_id = l.id left join user u1 on li.inviter_id = u1.id left join user u2 on li.invitee_id = u2.id where li.invitee_id = #{userId} and li.status = 0;
